categories.name: Data Correction
categories.definition: Request to fix/update incorrect supplier data (e.g., wrong bank details, address, tax ID).
examples: Supplier bank account number is incorrect in the system, needs correction
Please update the registered address for supplier ABC Corp
Tax ID on file for supplier is outdated and needs to be fixed

categories.name: Access/Permission
categories.definition: User cannot access supplier record/module, or gets a permission-related error.
examples: Getting 'Access Denied' when trying to open the Supplier module
User cannot view supplier records assigned to their business unit
Need permission to edit supplier records under my role

categories.name: Integration Failure
categories.definition: Sync/integration issue between Supplier module and another system (e.g., SAP, ERP).
examples: Supplier records not syncing to SAP after nightly batch job
ERP integration failing with timeout error for supplier updates
New supplier created in portal is missing in downstream ERP system

categories.name: Configuration Query
categories.definition: Question about how a setting/workflow is configured, not a defect.
examples: How is the supplier approval workflow configured for our region?
What triggers the auto-approval rule for low-risk suppliers?
Is it possible to configure a custom approval chain for new suppliers?

categories.name: Documentation/How-To
categories.definition: User asking how to perform an action, not reporting an error.
examples: How do I add a new supplier contact in the portal?
Steps to submit a supplier onboarding request
Where can I find the supplier compliance document upload option?

categories.name: Bug
categories.definition: Genuine defect/unexpected system behavior not covered by the other categories.
examples: Supplier search returns duplicate rows for the same supplier ID
Clicking 'Save' on supplier profile throws a 500 error
Supplier status shows 'Active' even after being deactivated

categories.name: Duplicate/Spam
categories.definition: Duplicate of an existing ticket, or not a genuine issue.
examples: Ticket is an exact duplicate of SUPPORT-1050 raised earlier today
Same request submitted twice by mistake

categories.name: Uncategorized
categories.definition: Fallback when confidence is below threshold or the ticket doesn't clearly fit any category above. Never chosen directly by the classifier - only assigned by the system fallback logic.
